target_definitions.base_close: last close available at the origin (available_at <= origin)
target_definitions.forward_direction_H: 1 when forward_return_H > 0, 0 when < 0, omitted when exactly 0
target_definitions.forward_return_H: close available at origin+H divided by base close, minus one
target_definitions.realized_volatility_H: population standard deviation of log returns between consecutive bar closes that became available in (origin, origin+H]
